import b200probe, inspect, torch, math, time
print(inspect.getsource(b200probe.Kernel)[:2500])
dev='cuda'
def tf32(t):
    i=t.contiguous().view(torch.int32)
    i=(i + 0xFFF + ((i>>13)&1)) & ~0x1FFF
    return i.view(torch.float32)
def f16(t): return t.half().double()
def run_row(B,C,H,W,atol,seed,variants):
    g=torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(seed)
    x=torch.randn(B,C,H,W,generator=g,device=dev)
    dw=torch.randn(C,1,7,7,generator=g,device=dev)/math.sqrt(7)
    dwb=torch.randn(C,generator=g,device=dev)
    W1=torch.randn(4*C,C,generator=g,device=dev)/math.sqrt(C)
    b1=torch.randn(4*C,generator=g,device=dev)
    gw=torch.randn(4*C,generator=g,device=dev)/math.sqrt(4*C)
    gb=torch.randn(4*C,generator=g,device=dev)
    W2=torch.randn(C,4*C,generator=g,device=dev)/math.sqrt(4*C)
    b2=torch.randn(C,generator=g,device=dev)
    W1d,W2d=W1.double(),W2.double()
    W1h=f16(W1)
    res={v:[0.0,0,0.0] for v in variants}
    CH=8
    for b0 in range(0,B,CH):
        xb=x[b0:b0+CH]; xd=xb.double()
        def tail(d,exact):
            Bc=d.shape[0]
            t=d.permute(0,2,3,1).reshape(Bc,H*W,C)
            if not exact: t=f16(t)
            mu=t.mean(-1,keepdim=True); var=((t-mu)**2).mean(-1,keepdim=True)
            a=(t-mu)/torch.sqrt(var+1e-6)
            pre=a@(W1d if exact else W1h).T + b1.double()
            h=0.5*pre*(1+torch.erf(pre/math.sqrt(2)))
            gf=torch.sqrt((h*h).sum(1,keepdim=True))
            nf=gf/(gf.mean(-1,keepdim=True)+1e-6)
            s=1+gw.double()*nf  # [Bc,1,4C]
            bb=W2d@gb.double()+b2.double()
            if exact:
                y=(h*s+gb.double())@W2d.T + b2.double()
            else:
                W2b=f16(W2d[None,:,:]*s)  # [Bc,C,4C]
                y=torch.bmm(f16(h),W2b.transpose(1,2))+bb
            return xd+y.reshape(Bc,H,W,C).permute(0,3,1,2)
        dref=torch.nn.functional.conv2d(xd,dw.double(),dwb.double(),padding=3,groups=C)
        ref=tail(dref,True)
        tol=atol+1e-5*ref.abs()
        for v in variants:
            if v=='fp32': d=dref
            elif v=='tf32': d=torch.nn.functional.conv2d(tf32(xb).double(),tf32(dw).double(),dwb.double(),padding=3,groups=C)
            elif v=='f16': d=torch.nn.functional.conv2d(f16(xb),f16(dw),dwb.double(),padding=3,groups=C)
            elif v=='hilo_x':
                xh=xb.half(); xl=(xb-xh.float()).half()
                d=torch.nn.functional.conv2d(xh.double()+xl.double(),f16(dw),dwb.double(),padding=3,groups=C)
            elif v=='hilo_k':
                kh=dw.half(); kl=(dw-kh.float()).half()
                d=torch.nn.functional.conv2d(f16(xb),kh.double()+kl.double(),dwb.double(),padding=3,groups=C)
            elif v=='hilo_xk':
                xh=xb.half(); xl=(xb-xh.float()).half(); kh=dw.half(); kl=(dw-kh.float()).half()
                d=torch.nn.functional.conv2d(xh.double()+xl.double(),kh.double(),dwb.double(),padding=3,groups=C)+torch.nn.functional.conv2d(xh.double(),kl.double(),None,padding=3,groups=C)
            out=tail(d,False)
            e=(out-ref).abs()
            r=res[v]; r[0]=max(r[0],e.max().item()); r[1]+=(e>tol).sum().item(); r[2]=max(r[2],(e*e).mean().sqrt().item())
    return res
t0=time.time()
V=['fp32','tf32','f16','hilo_x','hilo_k','hilo_xk']
for (B,C,H,W,atol) in [(64,96,112,112,3.8e-3),(32,128,64,64,3.2e-3)]:
    for seed in (200,201):
        res=run_row(B,C,H,W,atol,seed,V)
        for v in V:
            m,cnt,rms=res[v]
            print(f"{B},{C} seed{seed} {v:8s} max {m:.3e} ({100*m/atol:.0f}% atol) rms {rms:.2e} beyond {cnt}")
    print('t',time.time()-t0, flush=True)

class Kernel:
    def __init__(self, cubin, name):
        torch.zeros(1, device="cuda")                    # make torch's primary context current
        self.ctx = _ok(driver.cuCtxGetCurrent(), "cuCtxGetCurrent")
        self.module = _ok(driver.cuModuleLoadData(cubin), "cuModuleLoadData")
        self.fn = _ok(driver.cuModuleGetFunction(self.module, name.encode()), "cuModuleGetFunction")
        self.name = name

    def set_smem(self, nbytes):
        """Allow more than 48 KB of dynamic shared memory."""
        attr = driver.CUfunction_attribute.CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES
        _ok(driver.cuFuncSetAttribute(self.fn, attr, nbytes), "cuFuncSetAttribute")

    def __call__(self, grid, block, *args, smem=0, stream=None):
        _ok(driver.cuCtxSetCurrent(self.ctx), "cuCtxSetCurrent")   # driver contexts are per thread
        vals, types = [], []
        for a in args:
            if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor):
                vals.append(a.data_ptr()); types.append(ctypes.c_void_p)
            elif isinstance(a, i64):
                vals.append(int(a)); types.append(ctypes.c_int64)
            elif isinstance(a, int):
                vals.append(a); types.append(ctypes.c_int32)
            elif isinstance(a, float):
                vals.append(a); types.append(ctypes.c_float)
            else:
                raise TypeError(f"unsupported launch argument {type(a)}")
        g = tuple(grid) + (1,) * (3 - len(grid))
        b = tuple(block) + (1,) * (3 - len(block))
        s = stream if stream is not None else torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream
        _ok(driver.cuLaunchKernel(self.fn, *g, *b, smem, driver.CUstream(s), (tuple(vals), tuple(types)), 0),
            f"cuLaunchKernel({self.name})")
